metadata.title: Urban R&B Portrait with Script Overlay

retrievalProfile.description: A low-key urban portrait featuring a subject in streetwear leaning against a doorway with a prominent gold script signature overlay.
triggerTerms: low-key lighting with metal gate background

recipe.visualDefinition: A medium shot of a male figure in dark streetwear, leaning against a textured wall next to a metal security gate. The lighting is moody and directional, emphasizing metallic accessories like a large pendant and watch. A vibrant yellow-gold script logo is positioned horizontally across the center-right of the frame.
coreVisualRelationships: Subject leaning against the left frame edge creates a diagonal tension with the metal gate on the right.
The bright gold script contrasts sharply against the dark clothing of the subject.
Metallic highlights on the jewelry and belt buckle echo the vertical lines of the background gate.
The subject's downward gaze directs the viewer's eye toward the central typographic element.
coreInvariants: Low-key lighting with deep shadows in the clothing
Presence of a metallic security gate or industrial architectural element
Centralized script typography in a high-contrast warm hue

compositionAndHierarchy.subjectPositionAndScale: Subject occupies the left two-thirds of the frame, scaled from waist to head.
compositionAndHierarchy.visualAnchor: The large silver peace-sign pendant and the bright gold script logo.
compositionAndHierarchy.movementAndEyePath: Starts at the subject's face, follows the arm down to the hand on the gate, then moves across the script text.
compositionAndHierarchy.negativeSpace: Deep shadows within the doorway and the dark areas of the subject's shirt provide resting points.

colorSystem.dominantColorRole: Deep blacks and dark navy tones in the clothing and shadows.
colorSystem.contrastColorRole: Muted browns and grays from the architectural background.
colorSystem.accentColorRole: Vibrant golden yellow for the script and bright silver for jewelry highlights.
colorSystem.saturationAndValueRelationship: High value contrast between the dark background/clothing and the bright metallic/typographic accents.
paletteRestrictions: Avoid bright primary colors except for the gold accent

typographyAndGraphicLanguage.baseSkeleton: Cursive script with varying line weights
letterConstructionRules: Fluid, continuous strokes with exaggerated loops on ascenders
Thick-to-thin modulation mimicking a brush or felt-tip pen
Connected lowercase letters with detached, stylized uppercase initials
characterSpecificRedesigns: Uppercase 'B' features a large, open top loop
Uppercase 'V' has a sharp, elongated descent
The final 'o' or terminal letter often ends in a decorative flick
typographyAndGraphicLanguage.pairingStrategy: Standalone script logo; any secondary text should be a small, clean sans-serif for metadata.
graphicDevices: Drop shadow to separate text from dark background
Horizontal rule or architectural line used as a baseline

avoid: Blocky sans-serifs for the main name

candidateDirections.reason: Captures the fluid, personal signature aesthetic
Matches the street-culture context of the imagery

twoStageComposition.backgroundInstruction: Generate a portrait of a man in a black long-sleeve shirt and jeans leaning against a dark doorway next to a rusty metal accordion gate. Use low-key lighting with silver jewelry highlights.
twoStageComposition.overlayInstruction: Apply a large, golden-yellow cursive script signature across the middle-right of the image with a subtle dark outer glow for legibility.

verificationChecks: Is the script color a vibrant golden yellow?
Does the subject appear in a low-key, urban setting?
Is the jewelry rendered with high-contrast metallic highlights?
Is the text legible against the dark background?

adjustableVariables: Complexity of the metal gate background
mustRedesign: Any specific brand logos on the clothing
Identifiable facial features of specific celebrities

mustAchieve: Clear separation between subject and background

postGenerationChecks: Check that the script does not obscure the subject's face.
Ensure the gold color pops against the dark shirt.
Verify the metallic textures look realistic.
Confirm the composition feels balanced despite the off-center subject.
recipe.reuseFormula: Urban Portrait + Low-Key Lighting + Industrial Background + High-Contrast Script Overlay
